evidence.claim: SubhaloID for QG3 is inconsistently reported as either 184 or 884 between the main text/caption and Figure 13 panel titles, which can mislead attempts at reproducing analysis.
evidence.excerpt: On p. 13 the paper writes: "three massive QGs (the yellow stars, SubhaloID = 110, 111, 184, hereafter QG1, QG2, and QG3, respectively)", and the Figure 13 caption also lists "SubhaloID = 110, 111, 184". However, the top-panel titles of Figure 13 read "QG1 (subhaloID=110)", "QG2 (subhaloID=111)", "QG3 (subhaloID=884)". Either "184" or "884" is wrong. This matters because a reader wishing to reproduce the TNG300 analysis (halo assembly history, merger tree in Fig. 13; descendant SubhaloID=33174 at z=0) will pull the wrong halo.

This unresolved 184/884 mismatch is a real reproducibility issue.
